libgcrypt_1.8.14_msvc143_x64_libgcrypt-2.build_flags: /MD /O2 /Z7 (no /GL), --disable-asm (generic C, no hardware acceleration); /DEBUG /Brepro /INCREMENTAL:NO /OPT:NOREF /OPT:NOICF at link; configure by upstream, no make; BUILD-TREE SOURCE EDITS (variable-length arrays) - not byte-identical to unmodified upstream
libgcrypt_1.8.14_msvc143_x64_libgcrypt-2.compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35229 for x64
libgcrypt_1.8.14_msvc143_x64_libgcrypt-2.notes: Shared libgcrypt built with cl from the signed GnuPG release tarball, linked against the paired libgpg-error 1.35 built in the same step. NOT a build of unmodified upstream: configured with --disable-asm (generic C code, none of the amd64/AVX/AES-NI modules the MinGW and ELF legs contain) and with build-tree edits that replace variable-length arrays, which cl does not support, by constant-size arrays or _alloca() storage (cipher/cipher-ccm.c, mpi/ec.c, cipher/mceliece6688128f.c, cipher/sntrup761.c, as present in the release). The edits are applied by the build driver and printed as diffs in the build log; they are reproduced in the module docstring of scripts/corpus/recipes/libgcrypt_msvc.py. Upstream's make cannot run on the runner, so configure runs for real and the compile and link steps are reproduced from its generated Makefiles.
